questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending. You must move your vehicle to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic flows on this street. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. You must turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles or pedestrians go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You are about to enter a divided highway where traffic going in opposite directions is separated.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: The road will curve sharply to the right, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: There are multiple curves coming up on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign forbids right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending. You must move your vehicle to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. The new speed limit will be shown on the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you to a nearby fire station and tells you to watch for emergency vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Be alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs display traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot park at this location at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will curve right and then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal driving route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a stop sign is ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a side road is ahead and traffic may enter from that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Reduce speed and increase your following distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing where the tracks cross at a steep slope. Low-clearance vehicles may scrape or get caught on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If you drift off the road, do not brake suddenly or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that farm machinery may be present in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers not to block the intersection ahead. Do not enter the intersection if you cannot clear it completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn ahead. Reduce speed before the turn.
